ja: 僕のカードキーが使えなくなっただけじゃなくて、フロントにも30分も誰もいなかったんだ。
en: Not only did my key card stop working, but there was also nobody at the front desk for thirty minutes.
alternatives: Not only did my key card stop working, but no one was at the front desk for half an hour either.
Not only did my room key stop working, but there wasn't anyone at the front desk for thirty minutes.
point: Not only の後は did＋主語＋動詞の原形の語順

ja: すみません、部屋にタオルがもう少し欲しいんですが、いただけますか？
en: Could I get some more towels for my room?
alternatives: Can I have some more towels in my room?
Could you bring me some more towels, please?
point: towel は数えられるので複数形 towels にする

ja: チェックアウトするときに、荷物を夕方まで預かってもらえますか？
en: When I check out, could you keep my bags until this evening?
alternatives: Could you hold my luggage until this evening after I check out?
When I check out, can you store my bags until the evening?
point: 未来のことでも when 節は現在形の check out

ja: チェックアウトの前に、ミニバーの料金をちゃんと確認しておけばよかったなあ。
en: I wish I had checked the minibar charges before I checked out.
alternatives: If only I had checked the minibar charges before checking out.
I wish I'd looked at the minibar charges before I checked out.
point: 過去の後悔は wish + had + 過去分詞。wish I checked にしない

ja: 私たち、昨夜フロントに電話したんですが、誰も出なかったんです。
en: We called the front desk last night, but nobody answered.
alternatives: We called the front desk last night, but no one picked up.
Last night we called the front desk, but nobody answered.
point: 「電話に出る」は answer か pick up

ja: 私の部屋のエアコンに問題があります。
en: There's a problem with the air conditioner in my room.
alternatives: There's something wrong with the air conditioner in my room.
The air conditioner in my room isn't working properly.
point: 「問題がある」は There's a problem with 〜 で言う

ja: チェックアウトの前に、部屋をもう一度確認しよう。
en: Let's check the room again before we check out.
alternatives: Let's check the room once more before checking out.
Before we check out, let's check the room again.
point: 提案は Let's の後に動詞の原形を続ける

ja: シャワーのお湯が出なかったお詫びだと言って、フロントの人が彼に無料の朝食券をくれたんだ。
en: The front desk clerk gave him a free breakfast voucher, saying it was an apology for the hot water not working.
alternatives: The front desk gave him a free breakfast voucher, saying it was to apologize for the hot water not working.
The receptionist gave him a free breakfast voucher, saying it was an apology for the lack of hot water.
point: 「と言って」は文末に , saying を添えて表す

ja: チェックアウトの後、空港行きのシャトルバスが何時に出るか教えていただけますか？
en: Could you tell me what time the shuttle bus to the airport leaves after checkout?
alternatives: Could you tell me when the airport shuttle leaves after checkout?
Would you mind telling me what time the airport shuttle leaves after checkout?
point: 間接疑問は語順が平叙文。does it leave にしない

ja: 部屋の Wi-Fi につながらないんです。見てもらえますか？
en: I can't connect to the Wi-Fi in my room. Could you check it?
alternatives: I can't get on the Wi-Fi in my room. Could you take a look?
The Wi-Fi in my room isn't working for me. Could you check it?
point: 「つながらない」は can't connect to

ja: 1時間前にタオルを頼んだんですが、まだ届いていません。
en: I asked for towels an hour ago, but they haven't arrived yet.
alternatives: I requested some towels an hour ago, but they still haven't come.
I asked for towels an hour ago, and they haven't come yet.
point: ago は過去形、「まだ〜ない」は現在完了で分ける

ja: 眺めのいい部屋を頼んでいたのに、私が通された部屋からは駐車場しか見えません。
en: Although I'd asked for a room with a view, the one they gave me only looks out onto the parking lot.
alternatives: Even though I requested a room with a view, the room I was given only overlooks the parking lot.
I'd asked for a room with a view, but the one they put me in only faces the parking lot.
point: 頼んでいたのは通される前なので過去完了 I'd asked

ja: もっと早く予約してたら、彼女は禁煙の部屋に泊まれたのに。
en: If she had booked earlier, she could have gotten a non-smoking room.
alternatives: If she'd made a reservation earlier, she could've stayed in a non-smoking room.
She could have gotten a non-smoking room if she had booked earlier.
point: 過去の仮定は if had 過去分詞、could have 過去分詞

ja: シャワーがずっと冷たい水しか出ないので、どなたか部屋まで見に来ていただけないかと思いまして。
en: I was wondering if you could send someone up to take a look at the shower, because it keeps running cold.
alternatives: I was hoping you could send someone up to check the shower, since it keeps running cold.
Would it be possible to send someone up to look at the shower? It keeps running cold.
point: Could you より I was wondering if you could で柔らかく

ja: 彼女はチェックアウトの時に、手もつけていないミニバーの料金が請求されていたことに気づいたんです。
en: When she checked out, she noticed that she'd been charged for minibar items she had never touched.
alternatives: When she was checking out, she realized that she'd been charged for minibar items she never touched.
At checkout, she noticed that she'd been billed for things from the minibar that she hadn't touched.
point: 気づく前に請求済みなので she'd been charged と過去完了

ja: ネットで予約しておけば、今ごろ私たちはもう部屋でくつろいでいるのに。
en: If we had booked online, we'd already be relaxing in our room by now.
alternatives: If we'd made the reservation online, we would already be relaxing in our room.
If we had booked it online, we'd be relaxing in our room by now.
point: 過去の条件は had booked、今の結果は would be

ja: フロントの人、きっと私たちの予約の日付を間違えて入れたんだよ。
en: The front desk staff must have entered our reservation for the wrong date.
alternatives: The front desk clerk must have put our reservation in for the wrong date.
Someone at the front desk must have booked us for the wrong date.
point: 過去の推量は must have + 過去分詞。must entered にしない

ja: 隣の部屋の人たちが、もう2時間ずっと大きな音で音楽をかけているんです。
en: The people next door have been playing loud music for two hours.
alternatives: The guests next door have been playing loud music for two hours.
The people in the next room have been playing loud music for two hours.
point: 今も続く「ずっと〜している」は have been + ing

ja: 何時までにチェックアウトすればいいですか？
en: What time do I need to check out by?
alternatives: What time do I have to check out by?
What's the latest I can check out?
point: 「〜までに」の by を文末に置き忘れない

ja: この部屋より少し広い部屋はありますか？追加料金がかかっても構いません。
en: Do you have a slightly bigger room than this one? I don't mind paying extra.
alternatives: Is there a room a little larger than this one? I don't mind paying more.
Do you have anything a bit bigger than this room? I'm happy to pay extra.
point: 「少し広い」は slightly / a little を比較級の前に置く

ja: 私たちが困っているのは部屋の狭さではなく、隣の部屋の騒音なんです。
en: What's bothering us isn't the size of the room but the noise from the room next door.
alternatives: It's not the size of the room that's bothering us, but the noise from next door.
The problem isn't how small the room is, it's the noise from next door.
point: 「困っているのは A ではなく B」は What's bothering us isn't A but B

ja: 朝食は何時からですか？
en: What time is breakfast?
alternatives: When does breakfast start?
What time does breakfast start?
point: breakfast には a も the も付けない

ja: エレベーターの隣の部屋がうるさすぎたので、彼女は別の部屋に替えてもらったんだ。
en: The room next to the elevator was too noisy, so she had them move her to another one.
alternatives: The room next to the elevator was too loud, so she got them to move her to a different room.
Since the room beside the elevator was too noisy, she had them switch her to another room.
point: 「替えてもらった」は have 人 + 動詞の原形で had them move her
